<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace OrganiseYou\LlmGateway\Contract;

/**
 * A sample for the architecture test: a class of the contract that knows who answers. Works around a quirk of
 * Mistral.
 */
final readonly class AnswerQuirks
{
    public function __construct(public string $presetId) {}

    public function needsJsonRepair(): bool
    {
        return $this->presetId === 'lighton' || $this->isOpenAiCompatible();
    }

    private function isOpenAiCompatible(): bool
    {
        return str_starts_with($this->presetId, 'other-');
    }
}
